digest.component_or_area: Ruff linter configuration and datetime timezone handling
propositions: Ruff ASYNC and DTZ rule families must be enabled in the global Ruff configuration after all current diagnostics are resolved across src/rebar and tests.

Integer epoch timestamps must be converted to UTC using datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(created, tz=datetime.timezone.utc) and persisted timezone-less strings must be assigned UTC via datetime.datetime.strptime(...).replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc) to ensure consistent clustering.
Timestamp clustering behavior must produce identical UTC hour keys when the process TZ environment variable changes on platforms supporting time.tzset().
Security-pin cadence must use host-local calendar date obtained via datetime.datetime.now(tz=datetime.timezone.utc).astimezone().date() while passing an explicit tz argument to comply with DTZ005.
Production code under src/rebar must not contain the literal token datetime.UTC; all UTC construction must use datetime.timezone.utc to maintain Python 3.10 compatibility.
The exact Ruff security selector S must remain absent and .semgrep.yml, .semgrep.yaml, and .semgrep/ directories must not be present in the repository.
